snippet.title: Phantom Blade Zero - Special Teaser | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10017620

This is only the beginning of what's next for Phantom Blade Zero, a fast-paced action RPG built around authentic kungfu combat.
 
Full trailer and Pre-order Launch in Summer 2026.
 
A gameplay and story deep dive is coming to State of Play in late Summer 2026.
 
Phantom Blade Zero releases October 29, 2026.
